<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="21" x2="318" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="18" x2="323" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="15" x2="328" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="21" r="2.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <path d="M337 19 Q343 13 349 19" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <path d="M339 22 Q343 18 347 22" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="360" y="14" width="25" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="363" y="17" width="18" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="386" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="43.5" x2="390" y2="43.5" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="38,78 30,70 38,62" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="70" x2="49" y2="70" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="77" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">More Settings</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="31" y="135" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">App preferences</text>
    <text x="31" y="160" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Manage your CarCare app configuration</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Single update option card shadow -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="182" width="328" height="78" rx="10" fill="#0F172A" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="31" y="180" width="328" height="78" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="219" r="20" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
    <!-- update icon -->
    <path d="M70 205 A14 14 0 0 1 82 212" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M82 212 L82 206 M82 212 L76 212" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M70 233 A14 14 0 0 1 58 226" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M58 226 L58 232 M58 226 L64 226" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M65 207 L67 205 M73 205 L75 207" fill="none" stroke="#86CCE9" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M65 231 L67 233 M73 233 L75 231" fill="none" stroke="#86CCE9" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M56 216 L58 214 M84 216 L82 214" fill="none" stroke="#86CCE9" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M56 222 L58 224 M84 222 L82 224" fill="none" stroke="#86CCE9" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="103" y="215" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Update app version</text>
    <text x="103" y="237" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Current version 4.8.1</text>
    <polyline points="340,215 345,220 340,225" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Information panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="286" width="328" height="112" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="319" r="13" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <line x1="62" y1="313" x2="62" y2="322" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="327" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="88" y="317" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">Stay up to date</text>
    <text x="52" y="347" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Install the latest app version to enjoy</text>
    <text x="52" y="369" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">improved performance and new features.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="779" x2="390" y2="779" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="38,803 50,793 62,803" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="42" y="801" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="50" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Vehicles -->
    <g>
      <rect x="111" y="798" width="27" height="12" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="116" y1="798" x2="119" y2="793" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="133" y1="798" x2="130" y2="793" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="117" cy="812" r="2.2" fill="#64748B"/>
      <circle cx="132" cy="812" r="2.2" fill="#64748B"/>
      <text x="124" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Vehicles</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Community -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="198" cy="799" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <circle cx="188" cy="802" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <circle cx="208" cy="802" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="191" y1="811" x2="205" y2="811" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="198" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Community</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Notifications -->
    <g>
      <rect x="267" y="797" width="17" height="16" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="275.5" cy="795" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
      <circle cx="286" cy="796" r="4" fill="#52B6DF"/>
      <text x="275" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Alerts</text>
    </g>
    <!-- More active -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="350" cy="799" r="12" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
      <circle cx="344" cy="799" r="1.8" fill="#316D86"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="799" r="1.8" fill="#316D86"/>
      <circle cx="356" cy="799" r="1.8" fill="#316D86"/>
      <text x="350" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#316D86">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
